cards.back: 36 questions in 26 minutes ≈ 43 seconds per question. Use the on-screen calculator wisely — it's slow, so do mental maths for simple calculations.

To find a share: Total ÷ Sum of ratio parts × Individual part

Example: Ratio 3:2:1, Total 36 → Each part = 36÷6 = 6
First group = 3×6 = 18

Percentage change = (New - Old) / Old × 100

Compound interest: A = P(1 + r/100)^n

Speed = Distance / Time

Density = Mass / Volume

1. Read the question FIRST, then look at the data
2. Identify the relevant rows/columns
3. Estimate before calculating — eliminate impossible answers
4. Check units carefully (mg vs g, mL vs L)

Dose = Weight (kg) × Dose per kg
Volume = Dose ÷ Concentration

Example: 25kg child, 10mg/kg, 125mg/5mL
Dose = 25 × 10 = 250mg
Volume = 250 ÷ (125/5) = 10mL
